duration.text: The Short-Term Chinese Language Class at Jinggangshan University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 694 USD/per semester ￥ 5000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Jinggangshan University Application Form for Foreign Students’ Study in China (Download from website https://ice.jgsu.edu.cn/info/1046/1042.htm );2.The senior high school or above diplomas and the transcripts;3.Valid passport (scanned copy or photocopy);4.Non-criminal record provided by their residence police station or proof of school performance provided by his /her current school;5.An economic guarantee by a person (either a Chinese or a foreigner who has a regular job in China) or company, or an income proof from parent’s employed organization, or a bank saving statement of family;6.Physical examination result issued by officially recognized hospital;7.Photo (The requirements are the same as passport photo).

requirements.text: 1.All applicants should hold Senior School (or above) diploma(non-degreeprogram is not required).2.All applicants should hold a valid passport.3.Applicants for Clinical Medicine and Nursing Undergraduate Program should have 60% score or above of the courses in principle, such as English, chemistry and biology.4.Applicants for Civil Engineering Undergraduate Program should have 60% score or above of the courses in principle, such as English and mathematics.5.Applicants for 5-year Clinical Medicine Undergraduate Program(Chinese medium) should offer HSK4 or above certificate.6.Applicants should be good in character and holds non-criminal record.7.They should abide by the laws and regulations of Chinese government, obey the university regulations and respect Chinese people’s social custom and habits.8.In the process of reviewing applicants’ documents, the university will prefer to admit those who get higher marks in senior high school education.
